summary: The SystemOne integration is nearly implementable; the biggest gap is whether a model failure or missing JEV_TOKEN reaches the flow as a catchable FetchError or aborts the invocation.

questions.text: Does a Judge ModelFailure, including a missing or empty JEV_TOKEN, reach the guest flow as a catchable FetchError or abort the invocation as a host failure?
questions.reason: It fixes the reply's wire mapping, whether flows can fall back, and tool.failed (exit 1) versus operational failure (exit 3); 0027 says both 'sanitized host failures' and 'Failure terminates the flow through its existing error channel', and the flow channel is ExceptT FetchError.

questions.text: Is JEV_TOKEN resolved lazily on the first Judge request or eagerly when a tool or closed recipe starts?
questions.reason: Eager resolution makes non-judging tools fail on a fresh clone and puts SecretStore in every tool composition; 0027 says only 'Missing or empty keys refuse before constructing the provider', while 0028's 'absence is valid until a tool requests a model' covers model.dhall, not this secret.

questions.text: ADR 0005 makes Agentic's Probability a supported public ProbabilityScalar with storage and wire codecs, while ADR 0027 says Agentic values do not expand the public KB schema and authors project judgements into types such as integer basis points.
questions.reason: It decides whether facts, query results and tool outputs may persist Probability fields; 0005 'Recognize upstream Agentic.Questions.Probability as ProbabilityScalar ... Dhall Natural in 0..10000' vs 0027 'This does not expand the public KB schema subset'.
